CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_geometric_expansion {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
  HasSum (fun p => q ^ p.1 * q ^ p.2) ((1 - q)⁻¹ * (1 - q)⁻¹) ∧
    ∀ (u : ℂ),
      ‖u‖ = 1 →
        (∀ (p : ℕ × ℕ), ‖(↑q * u) ^ p.1 * (↑q * (starRingEnd ℂ) u) ^ p.2‖ = q ^ p.1 * q ^ p.2) ∧
          HasSum (fun p => (↑q * u) ^ p.1 * (↑q * (starRingEnd ℂ) u) ^ p.2) (↑(‖1 - ↑q * u‖ ^ 2))⁻¹
'CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_geometric_expansion' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_integral_hasSum (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (χ : Circle → ℂ)
  (hχ : Continuous χ) (hχnorm : ∀ (u : Circle), ‖χ u‖ ≤ 1) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
  HasSum (fun p => ∫ (u : Circle), χ u * ((↑q * ↑u) ^ p.1 * (↑q * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑u) ^ p.2) ∂μ)
    (∫ (u : Circle), χ u * (↑(‖1 - ↑q * ↑u‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ ∂μ)
'CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_integral_hasSum' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_actual_denominator_norm {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) {u : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
  ‖1 - ↑r * u‖ = r * ‖1 - ↑r⁻¹ * u‖

CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_normal_convergence {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hQ1 : Q < 1) :
  TendstoUniformlyOn (fun S x => ∑ p ∈ S, (↑x.1 * ↑x.2) ^ p.1 * (↑x.1 * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑x.2) ^ p.2)
    (fun x => ∑' (p : ℕ × ℕ), (↑x.1 * ↑x.2) ^ p.1 * (↑x.1 * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑x.2) ^ p.2) atTop {x | 0 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 ≤ Q}
'CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_angular_normal_convergence' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
CriticalLineAudit.complexPlace_actual_angular_integral_hasSum (μ : Measure Circle) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (χ : Circle → ℂ)
  (hχ : Continuous χ) (hχnorm : ∀ (u : Circle), ‖χ u‖ ≤ 1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) :
  HasSum (fun p => (↑r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ (u : Circle), χ u * ((↑r⁻¹ * ↑u) ^ p.1 * (↑r⁻¹ * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑u) ^ p.2) ∂μ)
    (∫ (u : Circle), χ u * (↑(‖1 - ↑r * ↑u‖ ^ 2))⁻¹ ∂μ)

 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
CriticalLineAudit.angular_diagonal (q : ℝ) (u : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
  (↑q * ↑u) ^ n * (↑q * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑u) ^ n = ↑q ^ (2 * n)

CriticalLineAudit.angular_monomial_integral (μ : Measure Circle) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [μ.IsMulLeftInvariant] (q : ℝ)
  (m n : ℕ) : ∫ (u : Circle), (↑q * ↑u) ^ m * (↑q * (starRingEnd ℂ) ↑u) ^ n ∂μ = if m = n then ↑q ^ (2 * m) else 0
